g.text: SD03 - Contextual AI Decision (UC03; F05, F09)
A new CLI line starts a new utterance. GUI speech enters the same flow through SD01.
The context also contains epoch, revision,
First update in this utterance: freeze baseContext = context.
Further partials reuse this base, so repeated "other way"
cannot alternate LEFT/RIGHT as held inputs change.
Dispatch metadata still uses the current context revision.
State: "other way", held RIGHT, previous command, session flags.
Choices describe bounded movement intents. No geometry or route is supplied.
[request is current and player can move]
Deterministic translation; the AI never constructs game commands.
[context, epoch, or version changed before completion]
[still latest version/epoch; only context revision changed]
Next fixed tick updates deterministic movement and publishes STATE_CHANGED (SD02).
"keep going" maps to KEEP_CURRENT, preserving both held inputs and any active timer.
"other way" without a usable directional context maps to NO_ACTION and requests clarification.
Neither choice plans a path. The player remains responsible for navigation.
